schema_sample.one_liner: Tiny (118 B), secure, URL-friendly unique string ID generator for JS/TS.
schema_sample.provides: ["collision-resistant unique IDs (21-char default, A-Za-z0-9_-)", "customAlphabet for custom length/charset", "hardware-RNG-backed, cluster-safe", "non-secure fast variant via nanoid/non-secure"]
schema_sample.requires: ["Node.js >=18 (ESM) or any modern browser", "crypto.getRandomValues / node:crypto present", "react-native-get-random-values polyfill on RN"]
schema_sample.assumptions: ["target runtime exposes a CSPRNG", "ESM import (or nanoid@3 for CommonJS require)"]
schema_sample.recipe: {"install": "npm install nanoid", "wire": ["import { nanoid } from 'nanoid'", "const id = nanoid()  // 'V1StGXR8_Z5jdHi6B-myT'", "// custom: import { customAlphabet } from 'nanoid'; const gen = customAlphabet('1234567890abcdef', 10)"]}
